notes.title: 10 Second Shuriken Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi,
I have some exciting news. Development of 10 Second Shuriken is nearly finished and the game will be launching on [b]Steam on the 29th of April  ːsteamhappyː Mark your calendars there will be a launch discount!
[/b]
I am also happy to say that the game will also be getting its[b] own ordinal soundtrack [/b]thanks to some music composers who agreed to do some custom music for the game.

notes.title: Update Time
notes.notes:
Hi,
I have some good news

I have a new trailer and updated the screenshots of 10 second shuriken on my steam page, you can check out all the new features that have been added.
Steam Page : 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1130440/10_Second_Shuriken/

One of them is that I have added powerups and changed how the movement of character feels he moves faster overall, which makes the game play feel and play in a more exciting way.
